programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Utah Mammoth and the Vegas Golden Knights meet for Game 1 of the Western Conference First Round at T-Mobile Arena. Utah won the regular-season series 2-1, including a dominant 4-0 shutout on March 19. Jack Eichel leads Vegas with 90 points.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Mammoth face the Golden Knights at T-Mobile Arena in Game 2 of the West first round. Vegas leads 1-0 after a 4-2 win. Logan Cooley scored the first playoff goal in Utah history while Mark Stone tied it and the Knights pulled the victory away.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Golden Knights face the Mammoth in Game 3 of the West first round at Delta Center. The series is tied after Utah won Game 2. Mark Stone scored early, but Dylan Guenther got the lead for Utah. Logan Cooley later pounced on a rebound for the win.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Golden Knights face the Utah Mammoth in Game 4 in Utah. The Mammoth lead 2-1 after a Game 3 win. Jack Eichel and Nic Dowd scored late, but Vegas could not overcome an early deficit. Karel Vejmelka made 29 saves to preserve the Mammoth victory.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Mammoth play the Golden Knights at T-Mobile Arena for Game 5 of the West first round. The series is tied 2-2 after Vegas won Game 4. The Golden Knights scored 5-4 behind Shea Theodore's winning goal. Utah stormed back with four unanswered goals.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Vegas Golden Knights face the Utah Mammoth in Game 6 of the West first round at Delta Center. Vegas leads 3-2 after winning Game 5. Pavel Dorofeyev recorded the sixth playoff hat trick in team history. Brett Howden scored the winner in second OT.
